scope: Full GDD UI system and mockups, not a working Roblox implementation
direction: Playful martial-arts dojo with parchment, deep blue-green panels, gold actions and jade equipment states

ink.role: Main dark canvas and text on bright accents

parchment.role: Main light canvas and text on dark panels

borderLight.role: Decorative dividers on light panels; never the sole control boundary

danger.role: Destructive action, error and low-HP alert

focus.role: Outer selection ring paired with ink inner ring

rules: No condensed or decorative body text.
Browser mockups use system rounded/sans fallbacks; final Roblox typography needs Studio verification.
Allow 30–50% copy expansion; test user text scaling to 150% as a project gate.
No looped decorative motion in menus.
Reduced motion replaces zoom/shake with opacity or instant state changes.
VR disables forced camera shake and camera hit-stop.
Proposed bindings, not final shipped bindings; validate conflicts and platform conventions in Studio.
Use active input rather than device name as the source of prompts.
Capture focus on opening a panel and restore it on closing.
Preserve Roblox system menu and default movement/jump reserved zones.

devices.phone: Touch-ready compact layouts; intended combat reference 844x390 landscape; narrow preview reflows instead of shrinking text.
devices.tablet: Keep action cluster close to thumb reach; do not anchor it at a fixed percentage of a large screen.
devices.desktop: Expanded side rail and keyboard prompts; resizable panels.
devices.console: Persistent two-tone focus, D-pad order, confirm/back and TV-readable type.
devices.vr: Comfortable world-space menu panel, controller-ray selection and readable labels; no forced shake. Browser preview is a layout study, not headset validation.

research.finding: Show the fighter before the economy
research.decision: Use one large active-fighter portrait and one primary Play button. Keep shop and season prompts secondary.
research.kind: Design recommendation from qualitative reference review; no usability test has been run.

research.decision: Use the same actions across touch, mouse/keyboard, gamepad and VR. Swap prompts without restarting the session.
research.kind: Platform guidance applied to this game.

research.decision: Keep timer and opponent status high, health low left, skills near the right thumb or lower center by input. Remove sales prompts during combat.
Four labeled elemental chips use colored fills; rarity uses a separate text badge and frame marker. Never recolor the full screen by rarity.
Use readable Details, guaranteed-item alternatives, clear pending receipts, and trade snapshots that reset both confirmations when an offer changes.
research.kind: Policy-informed interaction specification; server enforcement remains implementation work.

research.finding: Build a reusable kit for solo development
research.decision: Reuse fighter cards, action buttons, sheets, progress bars and state messaging across the full GDD. Keep portrait art separate from functional UI.
research.kind: Production recommendation for the user and Codex workflow.

components.name: Navigation rail and compact menu
components.specification: Persistent destination labels, selected state and unread count only for actionable items.

components.name: Player and economy header
components.specification: Avatar/name, Coins, trophies; contextual Raid Tokens or shards only where relevant.

components.name: Primary button
components.specification: Gold fill, ink label, strong bottom edge; idle/hover/pressed/focus/loading/disabled.

components.name: Secondary button
components.specification: Neutral panel with visible boundary; never compete with primary action.

components.name: Destructive button
components.specification: Danger fill plus explicit verb; separate from confirm; destructive operations need review.

components.name: Icon button
components.specification: Lucide concept icon plus accessible name; visible label for unfamiliar actions.

components.name: Element and class chips
components.specification: Element symbol + word + color. Class text stays independent of rarity.

components.name: Rarity badge
components.specification: Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary/Mythic text plus frame marker; no color-only meaning.

components.name: Fighter portrait
components.specification: Transparent portrait on controlled background; identity, no pricing baked into artwork.

components.name: Fighter card
components.specification: Name, element, level, rarity and ownership/equipped state; whole card selectable.

components.name: Stat row
components.specification: Named stat, numeric value, unit where needed; ranked adjustments explicitly labeled.

components.name: Skill button
components.specification: Action icon/name, current binding, numeric cooldown, ready state and blocked reason.

components.name: Ultimate meter
components.specification: Charge percentage or cooldown, consistent source rule, ready text and optional sound.

components.name: Dash/parry control
components.specification: Distinct shield icon and binding; 3s cooldown; separate from jump.

components.name: Contextual tag control
components.specification: Only in 2v2; backup identity and 12s cooldown without changing the three skill slots.

components.name: Health bar
components.specification: Numeric current/max HP; fill; low health uses icon/text as well as color.

components.name: XP and tier progress
components.specification: Current/required text plus fill, earned transition and claim state.

components.name: Status effect badge
components.specification: Icon, effect word and remaining duration; stack counts when needed.

components.name: Hazard warning
components.specification: World marker plus screen-edge label/countdown; preserve on low graphics.

components.name: Mode card
components.specification: Players, duration, ranked rules and party eligibility; selected state.

components.name: Queue status
components.specification: Elapsed time, mode, cancel; do not invent an exact ETA without data.

components.name: Tabs and segmented controls
components.specification: Visible selected state, preserved local state, directional navigation.

components.name: Search and filters
components.specification: Search label, clear, element filter, no-results reset; no typed input required for core actions.

components.name: Dropdown
components.specification: Selected value, keyboard/controller navigation and clear dismissal.

components.name: Toggle
components.specification: Word label and On/Off state; not color-only; optimistic state only if reversible.

components.name: Slider and stepper
components.specification: Value label, larger touch target and +/- alternative for gamepad.

components.name: Review dialog
components.specification: One question/task, readable content, visible back/cancel, trapped focus and restored focus.

components.name: Compact sheet
components.specification: Full-width or full-height mobile detail view rather than tiny desktop dialogs.

components.name: Info and details
components.specification: Accessible through touch and gamepad; never put essential purchase terms in hover-only content.

components.name: Toast and announcement
components.specification: Short success/info with visible text; error remains until resolved; never covers combat.

components.name: Empty state
components.specification: Cause and next action: no fighters found, no invites, no capsules.

components.name: Loading and skeleton
components.specification: Stable dimensions, status label, time-out recovery and reduced-motion fallback.

components.name: Error and retry
components.specification: Plain failure description, preserved data and retry/back option.

components.name: Transaction status
components.specification: Exact item/price, native purchase handoff, pending/fulfilled/cancelled/error.

components.name: Odds details
components.specification: All final outcomes, normalized percentages, actual active luck modifiers and read-before-purchase access.

components.name: Trade offer cell
components.specification: Persistent item instance ID in data, visible name/level/breed/mutation and changed marker.

components.name: Trade confirmation timer
components.specification: Five-second lock after any change, both acceptances reset, explicit second review.

components.name: Leaderboard row
components.specification: Rank, name, value, own-row emphasis, loading/empty/pagination states.

components.name: Reward tile
components.specification: Type, amount, track, locked/earned/claimable/claimed; no fake urgency.

components.name: Party slot
components.specification: Member identity, ready, leader, invite, offline and disconnected state.

components.name: Player label
components.specification: Filtered names, non-color team indicator; safe truncation with accessible full name.

components.name: Focus and selection indicator
components.specification: Two-tone 3px outer light / 2px inner ink ring; persistent on controller.

components.name: Binding hint
components.specification: Current key or platform-specific controller image; update on input switch.

components.name: Currency chip
components.specification: Symbol plus Coins/Trophies/Raid Tokens label; never make Coins resemble Robux.

components.name: Accessibility controls
components.specification: Reduced motion, opacity, larger text, captions, contrast, sound and camera-shake controls.

components.name: Spectator controls
components.specification: Target identity, previous/next and exit; supports no-target and ended-match state.

components.name: Rewarded-ad offer
components.specification: Deterministic named reward, eligibility/no-fill state, opt-in and safe-zone placement.

policyRules: Paid capsules are excluded from the first interactive purchase path until actual all-outcome odds and eligibility enforcement are finalized.
Earned reward capsules are granted directly by gameplay; paid Coins are not treated as a free-only currency.
Paid-random-item and paid-item-trading eligibility must be enforced on the server; unknown policy status blocks restricted transactions.
Rewarded video offers deterministic rewards and appears only for eligible users/devices after availability checks.
All trade offer changes reset both acceptances and the five-second timer; server atomicity is separate implementation work.
Custom clan/player text must be filtered; use preset banner shapes for the initial release.
openDecisions: GDD move-unlock schedule conflicts between sections; mockups show one available variant and one level-locked variant without claiming a final unlock schedule.
Ultimate charge versus fixed cooldown must be finalized per move before production HUD behavior.
Ranked rarity/breed normalization remains a game-balance decision; mockup says rules rather than claiming fully normalized stats.
Approve fighter portrait art style before generating the full 24-animal art library.

assetProvenance.role: Original concept portrait atlas, not production rigs or animation
assetProvenance.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single four-column character portrait atlas for Beast Dojo Critter Clash, an original cartoon martial arts arena game. Create four distinct original stylized 3D toy-like animal fighters, each framed from waist up, all at exactly the same scale, each centered in one of four equally wide columns across a wide horizontal image. Left to right: a warm caramel boxing kangaroo with long upright ears and teal cloth handwraps, an icy blue penguin brawler with a cream belly and orange scarf, a bulky charcoal silverback gorilla wearing jade wristwraps, a cheerful red-orange fire salamander with small ember spots and a dark martial arts belt. Confident expressive sporting poses, friendly competitive faces, rounded chunky silhouettes, rich soft materials, crisp edges, high quality game key art, soft studio lighting. Each fighter isolated against actual transparent alpha; leave clear transparent gaps between columns; no fighters overlap or cross their column boundaries; no ground, no scenery, no UI, no text, no logo, no watermark, no recognizable existing franchise character. Intended as four adjacent square portrait cells in one wide 4:1 strip, usable as one sprite sheet.
assetProvenance.status: Legacy visual concept; not cleared production art. Kangaroo production identity is Reedguard v2.
